name: Nurses
overview: Scripture highlights the compassionate and nurturing role of nurses, as seen when Moses' sister seeks a Hebrew nurse to care for the child (Exodus 2:7), reflecting the importance of caregiving. The imagery of a nursing father carrying a child in Numbers 11:12 emphasizes tender, protective care. Healing and meeting physical needs are integral to Christian service, as Jesus' disciples were sent to heal the sick (Luke 9:2) and to provide for the hungry and thirsty (Matthew 25:35). Proverbs 17:22 reminds us that a joyful spirit promotes health, underscoring the holistic nature of care in God’s kingdom.
